_comment: What every stealth package compiles under, and nothing about where it runs. A repository extends this once in its own tsconfig.base.json and adds the customConditions naming its source condition; a package extends that and states nothing further unless its shape differs. `types` is deliberately empty: left out, every @types/* anywhere in node_modules is in scope and a browser package silently sees node. node.json and web.json each add one environment, which is what makes that split mean anything. A package reaches its own source by the `#*` subpath its manifest declares, which is read from package.json rather than named here. `customConditions` names the condition every stealth repository resolves its own packages through; it must match the SOURCE constant in @stealthscale/config-vite, and a specification there asserts that it does.
_include: What every package compiles: its source, and the config that builds it. `${configDir}` is what makes this shareable — a relative path here would resolve against this file and compile nothing. A package with another shape states its own `include`, which replaces this rather than adding to it.
